Visualize WGCNA Module Networks

rna_wgcna_plot.Rd

Generates network visualizations from an existing WGCNA network, allowing the inspection of relationships between modules or the intramodular connectivity structure of an individual module.

Two visualization modes are available. The module network view represents relationships between module eigengenes using pairwise correlations, whereas the module detail view represents gene-level adjacency relationships within a selected module, highlighting highly connected hub genes.

The function uses the original WGCNA network and module assignments. It does not reconstruct the network, redefine modules, or recalculate module detection.

Usage

rna_wgcna_plot(
  project,
  view = c("module_network", "module_detail"),
  module = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  edge_threshold = NULL,
  hub_quantile = 0.9,
  layout = c("fr", "kk", "circle", "dh", "stress"),
  labels = TRUE,
  remove_isolated = FALSE,
  seed = NULL,
  plot = TRUE,
  save = FALSE
)

Arguments

project

An rna_project object containing a previously constructed WGCNA network result, generated by rna_wgcna.

view

Character string specifying the visualization type. Available options are:

"module_network"

Generates a network in which nodes represent modules and edges represent correlations between module eigengenes.

"module_detail"

Generates a gene-level network representing adjacency relationships within a selected module, with hub genes highlighted.

Defaults to "module_network".

module

Character string specifying the module to visualize when view = "module_detail". Must match an existing module identifier in the WGCNA network. Unassigned genes (grey module) cannot be selected. Defaults to NULL.

group

Character string specifying the metadata group used for group-specific visualization. If NULL, the global network data are used. When a group is specified, the corresponding expression data and module eigengenes are used for the selected visualization, while the original global module assignments are retained. Defaults to NULL.

edge_threshold

Numeric value specifying the minimum edge strength required for an edge to be included in the visualization. Its interpretation depends on the selected view:

"module_network"

Minimum absolute Pearson correlation between module eigengenes. Values range from greater than 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.30.

"module_detail"

Minimum gene-to-gene adjacency value within the selected module. Values range from greater than 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.10.

hub_quantile

Numeric value between 0 and 1 specifying the quantile used to identify hub genes in the "module_detail" view. Genes with intramodular connectivity (kWithin) at or above the corresponding quantile are classified as hub genes. Defaults to 0.90.

layout

Character string specifying the graph layout algorithm used by ggraph. Common options include "fr" (Fruchterman-Reingold), "kk" (Kamada-Kawai), "circle", "dh", and "stress". Defaults to "fr".

labels

Logical. If TRUE, displays module identifiers in the "module_network" view and hub gene labels in the "module_detail" view. If FALSE, suppresses all node labels in both visualization modes. Defaults to TRUE.

remove_isolated

Logical. If TRUE, removes nodes without connections from the generated network visualization. If FALSE, all nodes are retained, including isolated nodes. This argument applies to the "module_network" view. Defaults to FALSE.

seed

Optional integer used for reproducibility.

plot

Logical. If TRUE, prints the generated visualization. If FALSE, returns the visualization object without displaying the plot. Defaults to TRUE.

save

Logical. If TRUE, attaches the visualization result to the project under the analyses slot with subtype "wgcna_plot" and invisibly returns the updated project. If FALSE, does not attach the result and instead invisibly returns an object of class wgcna_plot_result. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

If save = TRUE, invisibly returns the updated rna_project object.

If save = FALSE, invisibly returns an object of class wgcna_plot_result, containing:

plot

The generated ggraph/ggplot visualization. May be NULL when plot = FALSE.

graph

An igraph object containing the network structure and associated node and edge attributes.

nodes

Data frame containing node-level information, including module assignments, module colors, gene identifiers, connectivity information, and visualization attributes. The exact columns depend on the selected view.

edges

Data frame containing the network edges and their associated correlation or adjacency attributes, depending on the selected view.

correlation

Matrix of pairwise module eigengene correlations for the "module_network" view. Returns NULL for the "module_detail" view.

parameters

List containing the selected visualization parameters, group information, sample count, network dimensions, edge threshold, layout, and hub identification settings when applicable.

timestamp

Date and time at which the visualization object was generated.

Details

The module network view summarizes relationships between modules using Pearson correlations between their eigengenes. Each node represents a module, with node size proportional to the number of assigned genes. Edges represent pairwise eigengene correlations exceeding the selected absolute correlation threshold. Positive and negative correlations are visually distinguished.

The module detail view reconstructs the adjacency relationships between genes belonging to the selected module using the expression data available for the selected group. Gene connectivity is quantified using intramodular connectivity (kWithin), calculated as the sum of adjacency values connecting each gene to the other genes in the same module. Edges are retained according to the selected adjacency threshold.

Hub genes are identified from the distribution of intramodular connectivity values. The selected hub_quantile defines the minimum connectivity quantile used for hub classification. Hub genes are highlighted in the visualization and labeled using available gene symbols. When a gene symbol is unavailable, the corresponding gene identifier is used instead. Duplicated gene symbols are disambiguated using their original gene identifiers.

When group-specific visualization is requested, the original global module assignments are retained. However, eigengene correlations and gene-level adjacency relationships are evaluated using the expression data from the selected group. Consequently, differences between group-specific visualizations may reflect changes in expression relationships and connectivity patterns, as well as differences in sample size and expression variability.

These visualizations are intended for exploratory network inspection and biological interpretation. Correlations and adjacency values represent network relationships and should not be interpreted as evidence of direct molecular interactions, causal relationships, or statistically significant differences between groups.

The selected graph layout determines the spatial arrangement of nodes and does not represent biological distance or interaction strength independently of the network edges.
